subject: Comp-band exception request: Morgan Singh (Sr. Platform Eng) - competing offer
messages:
From: Morgan Singh <morgan.singh@gmail.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Update — competing offer and tight timeline

Hi Neha,

Quick update — I had another conversation with FastScale yesterday and they sent a verbal offer this morning. Their package is significantly higher on base ($250k vs Redwood's $220k) and they pushed a 48-hour decision window. I wanted to be transparent because I really like the team and role at Redwood, but the timeline is compressed and compensation is the sticking point.

If there is any flexibility on base or sign-on, I can prioritize Redwood. Otherwise I may need to move quickly to meet their deadline. Appreciate anything you can share.

Thanks,
Morgan

Attachment: FastScale_offer_summary.png (screenshot)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Update — competing offer and tight timeline

Laura / Karthik — forwarding Morgan's note. Candidate has verbal offer with a 48h deadline. Current official Redwood offer (attached) is: base $220,000, target equity 0.45% (4-year), standard sign-on 0.

We need guidance on whether we can:
- Increase base (target +X% to match/move closer)
- Offer a one-time sign-on
- Approve a comp-band exception for this hire (role is at Senior Platform Eng band)

Morgan is strong and the hiring manager (Laura) recommends we try to keep him. If we can only move on one lever, Laura prefers base increase + modest sign-on. Decision window is tight — candidate asked for an update within ~6 hours.

Attachments: Offer_Sr_Platform_Engineer_v1.pdf (PDF), Morgan_Singh_Resume.pdf (PDF)

Can you advise ASAP so I can respond?

Neha
Recruiter | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Update — competing offer and tight timeline

Thanks for flagging. Morgan is exactly the hire we need for the platform reliability sprint. I support an aggressive counter. My recommendation: match base to $240k and add a $15k sign-on (structured as taxable retention if accepted within 7 days). If comp-band policy prevents matching $240k, we should approve a band exception — I can cover ~$10k of the delta from my hiring budget; we'd need central approval for the remainder.

Given the 48h clock, I'd ask Karthik and HR/Comp to triage immediately. If we can get a provisional approval I can expedite verbal confirmation to Morgan.

-Laura
Director, Platform Engineering

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Comp-band options and constraints

Laura / Neha — quick note on comp rules and options we can execute rapidly: 
1) Band stretch (manager-approved exception): We can move a candidate up to +7% above the band midpoint without exec approval. Anything beyond that requires VP approval and a comp justification (attached).
2) Sign-on: A one-time payment of up to $20k is available from the hiring budget without exec approval. Anything above $20k requires finance sign-off.
3) Equity: We can flex RSU target slightly in range but not materially change level without calibration from comp.

If Laura is willing to cover $10k from her budget, the easiest path to get Morgan to $240k is: approve +7% band-stretch on base (from $220k to ~$235k) + $15k sign-on (manager + comp approve). For full $240k we need VP sign-off for the remaining delta (~$5k) or convert some into sign-on.

I attached a short justification template; if Laura can sign off I can route to Vivek for immediate approval.

Attachment: Comp_Band_Justification_2026-06-18.pdf (PDF)

Karthik
Sr. Manager, Talent Operations

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval request: comp-band exception for Morgan Singh — 48h deadline

Vivek — forwarding briefly. Morgan Singh (Sr. Platform Eng candidate) has a competing verbal offer and a 48-hour decision window. Recruiter and comp team propose: 
- Option A (fast): band-stretch +7% (manager-approved) + $15k sign-on — immediate.
- Option B (preferred): move base to $240k + $15k sign-on (requires VP sign-off for band exception beyond +7%).

I can absorb $10k from my hiring budget; the remaining delta to $240k is small (~$5k base) but policy requires your sign-off. Karthik attached the comp justification. Please let me know if you approve Option B or if we should proceed with Option A now to avoid losing the candidate. Candidate expects an update within the afternoon.

Thanks for the quick read — I know this is last-minute.

Laura

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: finance_ops@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: comp-band exception for Morgan Singh — 48h deadline

Thanks for the clear summary. I approve a limited comp-band exception to secure Morgan: increase base to $235,000 (which aligns with the +7% band-stretch) plus a $15,000 sign-on. Laura, I appreciate you covering $10k; we will fund the remainder from central hiring reserves. This is contingent on candidate accepting within 36 hours and background checks completing without issue.

Neha — please send an updated offer with the new numbers and note the acceptance deadline. Karthik / Finance — please confirm any payroll/tax paperwork needed for the sign-on.

Vivek
VP Engineering
